mainEntity.name: When should I consult a wrongful termination lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider consulting a wrongful termination lawyer if you believe your termination was based on discrimination, retaliation, or violated a contract or public policy. It's often best to seek advice early, even if you're unsure, as there are strict deadlines for filing claims. A lawyer can assess your situation, explain your rights, and help determine the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consult a wrongful termination lawyer if you suspect your firing was illegal due to discrimination, retaliation, or contract breach. Early consultation is advised due to strict deadlines.
